WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT f.rebrate, f.feerate, o.timespan
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN rebrate / feerate END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY timespan
),
avg_count_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as overall_avg_count
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.avg_ratio,
    gs.count,
    ac.overall_avg_count
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN avg_count_calc ac
  WHERE gs.count > ac.overall_avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(count - overall_avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
